name: manuscript-skills
description: Prepare AI-assisted manuscripts for 2026 journal desks: check them against what editors and integrity screeners reject (unresolvable or retracted references, chatbot leftovers, missing AI disclosures, venue limits, AI-science design gaps), rank journals by how hard their AI policy falls on the paper, adapt the manuscript to the chosen venue, and copy-edit AI-sounding prose under a contract that a guard script checks for changed numbers, citations, hedges and negations.
